package.name: ros2_rviz_plugins
package.description: RViz2 GUI plugins. NavSinglePanel sends goals to the /nav_single action (w_behavior_tree_interfaces/action/NavSingle) served by w_behavior_tree::NavSingleNavigator. A dedicated NavSingleGoalTool publishes the clicked goal pose to a private topic (/nav_single/goal_pose) so the input path is fully isolated from nav2's Navigation 2 panel and GoalTool. See README for design notes.
